purpose: Generic animated loading placeholder for composing field, list, and content skeleton layouts.
useWhen: Content is loading and the layout should reserve space with a placeholder shape.
Multiple skeleton pieces need to compose a page or component loading state.

avoidWhen.situation: A Button is waiting on an in-flight press action.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use Button isLoading or isPending rather than replacing the button with Skeleton.

avoidWhen.situation: Only an indeterminate indicator or pending label is needed.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use Spinner or LoadingText instead of layout placeholders.

approvedPatterns: Compose Skeleton elements to mirror the loaded layout's geometry, including input, avatar, and card shapes.
Size skeletons with layout classes rather than inventing one-off loading components.
Do not assume other components expose a skeleton mode; compose Skeleton instead.
limitations: Skeleton is decorative only and does not announce loading status by itself.
Pair skeletons with an appropriate live-region or busy state on the real content container when needed.
Input and Avatar do not ship built-in skeleton modes.
accessibility: Renders with aria-hidden so assistive technology skips decorative placeholders.
responsive: Fill the intended slot; constrain width and height in the surrounding layout.
